title: icp.scored event (v6)
description: One event per row, posted by the Clay ICP table to n8n Path B. It carries NO score: the table classifies and enriches, n8n scores. Everything the Score node needs to produce a grade is here, and nothing that would let the table produce one instead. `additionalProperties: false` throughout, with one deliberate allowance — a short list of provenance keys that carry no weight (`event`, `event_id`, `emitted_at`, `clay_table`, `clay_row_url`) may be present and is ignored, so the table adding a trace field does not reject a run.

request_id.description: the n8n correlation id issued on Path A; the Path B dedupe key

org_id.description: numeric, as Pipedrive has it and as Path A sends it

requested_at.description: when Path A asked; the table's "today" for days-open arithmetic, and what the Contracting guard measures evidence age against

domain.description: the ONE identifier, echoed back from the Path A request. The organization's Pipedrive Website URL normalised to a bare host: lowercase, no scheme, no www., no path. There is no name or LinkedIn fallback — an organization with no usable website is never sent to the table, so every event that arrives has one.

resolved.description: What the table resolved the domain to. Trace only: Path B writes two organization fields and nothing else, so none of this reaches Pipedrive. Kept because a run that scored the wrong company is diagnosed from here.

engineering_hiring.description: The hiring picture behind stage_maturity and buying_signal. Every count may be null: a jobs provider that returned nothing and a company hiring nobody are opposite facts, and `dates_available: false` is how the table says it could not tell.

activation_evidence_dated.description: A CITATION, not a boolean: the evidence item the state rests on, e.g. "apollo.funding_events[0].date: 2025-09-01". The Contracting guard reads a date out of it and asks whether it names a layoff or hiring freeze.

geography.description: Confidence and missing_inputs are optional here — §3 of the task shows geography without missing_inputs. Accepting either shape costs nothing; rejecting a run because a sibling key travelled would cost a score.

revenue_range.description: The only component that names where its number came from. The note prints `revenue_source` so a rep can see that a band came from a headcount heuristic rather than a filing.

buying_signal.description: Weight 0 in the rubric — carried for the note and the audit row, never for the composite. Confidence and missing_inputs optional, as §3 shows it with neither.

conflict_note.description: Free text when two sources disagreed. Reaches the note and the audit row; never the score.

apollo_summary.description: The firmographic reading behind the levels. headcount_6mo_growth is load-bearing: it is the first test the Contracting guard applies.

event_id.description: ignored for routing; sharpens the dedupe key when present

emitted_at.description: ignored; n8n stamps its own rows

evidence.description: Bounded only to stop an unbounded payload. The note and the audit row both trim, so rejecting a whole scoring event over a seventh evidence string would be the wrong trade.
